agent_assessment.summary: Investigation of Case HHG-003 for Customer C08623 reveals that transaction 3530164 ($49.00, in_person) originated from billing region 330.0, which has been visited and used 51 times previously by the cardholder. While the customer has a history of prior confirmed fraud cases, those incidents specifically involved out-of-region usage and account takeover patterns. In contrast, this transaction occurs in a highly familiar, established region for the cardholder, features a modest amount below the customer's average, and was executed via an in-person channel.
